name: MoEngage
shortInfo: Enable data streams from your data warehouse to MoEngage automatically
brief: This sync enables adding or updating users and user properties in MoEngage directly from your data warehouse
about:
Lead with Insights, Engage with Heart. MoEngage is an insights-led Customer Engagement platform for consumer brands, that empowers marketers and product.  
  
Learn more about [MoEngage](https://www.moengage.com/).
availableSync:
[User](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/moengage/syncs/user.html)

This sync can be used to request and retrieve users and user properties from a user specified data warehouse for the MoEngage platform.  
  
Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/moengage/index.html) here.
